MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  Special Meeting of the City Council, Successor Agency
  of the Community Development Agency, the
  Community Development Financing Authority,
  and the Housing Authority
  December 21, 2012

A Special Meeting of the City Council, the Successor Agency of the Community Development
Agency, the Community Development Financing Authority, and the Housing Authority of the
City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor/Chair Ury at 9:31 a.m.,
on December 21, 2012, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 9:30 a.m. on December 20, 2012, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

Present:  Council/Agency Member Kelley (arrived at 9:37 a.m.)
  Council/Agency Member Leckness
  Council/Agency Member Schlicht
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Reardon (arrived at 10:05 a.m.)
  Mayor/Chair Ury

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager/Executive Director
  Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Assistant Executive Director
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services
  Robert Schick, Deputy City Clerk/Secretary

PLEGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Leckness

CLOSED SESSION

CS1.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL -- ANTICIPATED LITIGATION

  Based on existing facts and circumstances, the City Council, Successor Agency and
  Financing Authority will confer with legal counsel and provide direction regarding (i)
  whether or not to initiate litigation pursuant to Section 54956.9(c) - one potential case, and
  (ii) significant exposure to litigation pursuant to Section 54956.9(b) - one potential case.

CS2.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL -- ANTICIPATED LITIGATION

  Based on existing facts and circumstances, the City Council, Successor Agency, and
Special Meeting Minutes  1  December 21, 2012
   Housing Authority will confer with legal counsel and provide direction about whether
  or not to initiate litigation pursuant to Section 54956.9(c) – two potential cases.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 9:34 a.m., Mayor/Chair Ury recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City
Council reconvened at 10:53 a.m. with all five City Council/Agency Members present.

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley announced that for Closed Session item CS1, the City
Council/Agencies received extensive updates on the circumstances dealing with the State. The
City Council directed staff to not proceed with litigation however staff will be communicating
with the State to resolve some ambiguities. The motion passed with a vote of 4-1 (Mayor/Chair
Ury was in dissent.)

For item CS2, regarding the Shops at Mission Viejo and the Simon property refinancing, Council
authorized the City Manager to proceed as may be required if it is consensual with the
City/Simon. If the transaction is not consensual, the Council authorized the City/Agency to
pursue litigation to maintain the City’s rights under the existing covenant agreements. The
motion passed with a vote of 5-0.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

There were no public comments.

1.  CITY COUNCIL CONSENT TO CERTAIN TRANSFERS PURSUANT TO
  MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT FOR PUBLIC PARKING STRUCTURES
  BETWEEN THE CITY OF MISSION VIEJO AND MISSION VIEJO
  ASSOCIATES, L.P.

  Special Counsel Celeste Brady presented the staff report.

  Mayor/Chair Ury vacated the dais at 10:56 a.m. and returned at 11:00 a.m. During that
  time, Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Reardon presided over the meeting.

  Larry Gilbert, M.V.: asked why there was a need for a special meeting now and why
  information was not shared with the public and the City Council prior to this. He
  stated that the City Council and residents should have had more time to review the
  background materials.

  City Manager Wilberg noted that the Council did address this matter in Closed Session
  on December 3, 2012. Staff followed the Council’s direction and therefore today’s
  meeting is a result of the culmination of the December 3 direction.

  Mr. Gilbert asked questions of the City Council and the City Attorney.

Special Meeting Minutes  2  December 21, 2012
   Motion made by Council/Agency Member Kelley, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem/Vice
  Chair Reardon , to consent to transfers and authorize City Manager and City Attorney
  (and special counsel) to execute, and as necessary City Clerk to attest, the necessary
  assignment/assumption agreement and related consent instrument(s).

  On roll call, motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 11:16 a.m. with no further business to come before the Council/Agencies at this
session, Mayor/Chair Ury adjourned the meeting to Monday, January 7, 2013, at 5:00 p.m.

______________________________________________
Robert Schick, Deputy City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of January 21, 2013
